Type of food: Eat foods containing iron to prevent  anemia and eat foods with vitamin B to provide energy.
Concentration Levels: Through this phase you might feel a difference on how well you can process infomoation, as well as having harder time memorizing and lower attention. This is due to the lower amounts of estrogen levels.
Health aspect: The average menstrual phase is 5 days, however this can vary depending on the person. This variation may alter the length of your menstrual cycle. If your overall cycle is longer than 35 days that can be a sign of  or shorter than 21 days. If you have concerns, contact your doctor.
Types of Vitamins: While on your period you can take iron supplements to make up for the iron lost in blood and to prevent fatigue. Before taking any supplements, please contact your doctor.
